messages.subject: Wendy | Mining & Industrial Executive | External Affairs, ESG & Responsible Business
messages.body:
Dear Wendy,

I am sending my profile directly because ArcelorMittal's current recruitment channel invites CV submissions, and my background sits close to the intersection of mining, industrial operations, ESG and stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, compliance coordination, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

I also support stakeholder governance around a large solar and battery-storage platform and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation, expatriate and regional assignments.

I have attached an ArcelorMittal-tailored executive CV. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming leadership opportunities, or referral to the appropriate senior hiring team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
